27, 2022 at 6:00 PM.

   A motion was made by Vice Chairmember Rodriguez, seconded by
  Commissioner Navarro, direct staff to comeback at the next regularly scheduled
  Planning Commission meeting with resolutions of denial, as it pertains to the
  General Plan Amendment and Zoning Change from C-4 to R-4 based on a lack of
  parking, increase in traffic, and inadequate open space.

  The motion Carried by the following vote:

  AYES: 3; Winford, Navarro, Rodriguez
  NOES: 1; Roman
  ABSENT: 1; Hernandez
  RECUSE: 0;

  Motion Carried: 3–1–1–0

  A motion was made by Chairmember Winford, seconded by Commissioner
  Roman, adopt Resolution No. 2022-006 considering Case No. PLNG2021-0025
  (Site Plan Review), a request to approve the site plan and architectural design of
  a new 13-unit apartment complex on property located at 12345 Carson Street
  City of Hawaiian Gardens, California, with the condition that if the City Council
  were to find the Development consistent with the General Plan Amendment and
  Zoning amendment, then the Planning Commission recommends approval.

  The motion Failed by the following vote:

  AYES: 2; Roman, Navarro
  NOES: 2; Winford, Rodriguez
  ABSENT: 1; Hernandez
  RECUSE: 0;

  Motion Failed: 2–2–1–0

  A dialogue ensued between Chair Winford, Patrick Donegan, Assistant City
  Attorney, and Vice Chair Roman.

  A motion was made by Vice Chairmember Rodriguez, seconded by
  Commissioner Navarro, direct staff to come back with a resolution of denial for
  site plan Case No. PLNG2021-0025 based on the inability to find consistency
  with the General Plan and Zoning Ordinance.

  The motion Failed by the following vote:

  AYES: 2; Winford, Rodriguez
  NOES: 2; Roman, Navarro
  ABSENT: 1; Hernandez
  RECUSE: 0;
